logo-alt: Alt text for the Dustpan logo image

search-wikiproject-label: Label displayed before the WikiProject selection combobox.
search-wikiproject-placeholder: Placeholder text shown in the WikiProject combobox before a WikiProject is selected
search-query-label: Label displayed before the query type combobox. The options describe types of missing information to find within the selected WikiProject
search-query-placeholder: Placeholder text shown in the category combobox before a category is selected
search-scope-placeholder: Placeholder text shown in the optional scope combobox before a scope is selected. The available scope depends on the selected WikiProject and category
search-scope-no-results: Message shown in the scope combobox when no results match the search input

search-geographic-scope-all: Option in the scope combobox for including all geographic scopes in the search
search-no-scope-placeholder: Placeholder text shown in the scope field when no additional scope is available for the selected category
search-heading: Heading for the search panel section
search-button: Label for the button that executes the search
search-show-panel: Button text to expand and show the search and filter panel after results are displayed
search-show-panel-aria: Aria label for showing the search and filter panel when no filters are active
search-show-panel-aria-with-filters: Aria label for button to show search and filter panel with active filter count. $1 = number of active filters. Translator MUST use {{PLURAL}}.
search-hide-panel-aria: Aria label for hiding the search and filter panel
search-panel-filter-clear-notice: Notice message shown below the Search button when filters are active, indicating that a new search will clear all filters

contribution-info-expand-aria: Aria label for the button to expand the contribution information and show the contribution details
contribution-info-collapse-aria: Aria label for the button to collapse the contribution information and hide the contribution details
contribution-info-example-label: Label for the example shown in the detailed contribution information
results-querying: Heading text shown while the query is in progress
results-querying-aria: Aria label for the progress bar while querying Wikidata
filters-heading: Section heading for the filter controls area
filters-clear-all: Button text to reset all active filters to their default state
filters-text-placeholder: Placeholder text shown in text input for filtering by QID or Label
filters-text-label-aria: Aria label for the text input filter field

table-visited-header: Aria label for the visited status column header in results table
table-visited-yes: Aria label for icon indicating an item has been visited
table-visited-no: Aria label for icon indicating an item has not been visited
table-result-count: Caption showing number of results. $1 = number of results. Translator MUST use {{PLURAL}}.
table-item-id-header: Column header for Q identifier (LID) in results table
table-label-header: Column header for label in results table
table-all-visited: Message shown when all items in results have been marked as visited
table-no-results: Message shown when query returns no results
table-try-query: Suggestion message shown when no results found, instructing user to clear filters or try different search parameters
table-hide-visited: Button text to toggle on/off to hide items that have been visited
table-hide-visited-aria: Aria label for button text to toggle on/off to hide items that have been visited
table-hidden-count: Text showing how many visited items are currently hidden from the table. $1 = number of hidden items. Translator MUST use {{PLURAL}}.
table-visibility-none-hidden: Message shown when there are no visited items to hide from the results table
table-visibility-hidden-announce: Message announcing the number of visited items hidden from the results table. $1 = number of hidden items and uses {{PLURAL}}
table-header-qid-default: Aria label for QID column header in default sort state
table-header-qid-ascending: Aria label for QID column header when sorted ascending
table-header-qid-descending: Aria label for QID column header when sorted descending
table-header-label-default: Aria label for label column header in default sort state
table-header-label-ascending: Aria label for label column header when sorted ascending
table-header-label-descending: Aria label for label column header when sorted descending
cdx-table-pagination-status-message-dete: Short pagination status showing current row range and total. $1 = first row number in current page, $2 = last row number in current page, $3 = total number of rows.
Long pagination status showing current row range and total. $1 = first row number in current page, $2 = last row number in current page, $3 = total number of rows.
cdx-table-pager-items-per-page-current: Shows the number of rows per page currently selected by the user. $1 = number of rows. Translator MUST use {{PLURAL}}.
cdx-table-pager-button-first-page: Aria label to table first page
cdx-table-pager-button-last-page: Aria label to table last page
cdx-table-pager-button-next-page: Aria label to table next page
cdx-table-pager-button-prev-page: Aria label to table previous page
cdx-dialog-close-button-label: Aria label for the close button in Codex dialogs
state-on: Label for on state of a toggle
state-off: Label for off state of a toggle

errors-reload-prompt: Suggestion to reload the page when connection fails
errors-reload-page: Button text to reload the page
errors-wikiproject-not-found: Error message shown when user enters an invalid WikiProject
errors-query-not-found: Error message shown when user enters an invalid query type
errors-query-failed: Error message shown when the Wikidata query fails
footer-powered-by: Text crediting Wikidata as data source
footer-source: Link text to source code repository
footer-by: Preposition before Wikicollabs link, as in 'created by Wikicollabs'

footer-about-aria: Aria label for About footer link, opens in new tab
